sections.heading: Overview
body: Two independent slots (A and B) run in parallel, each
with its own pattern, MIDI channel, and bank set.
Load a resonant monosynth into a shadow slot (303,
Bristol, OB-Xd, Moog, …) and match its receive channel
to the slot you want to drive.

sections.heading: Slots & Modes (T1–T4)
body: T2  Slot A — 303  (live CC controller for a 303)
T4  Slot B — 303  (live CC controller for a 303)
Both slots sequence at all times. Track buttons just
switch which slot the 8 knobs and pads are editing.
a 303-mode button is dark unless a 303 plugin is loaded.

sections.heading: Knobs — 3PO mode
body: 1  Density    — chance of a note vs a rest per step
2  Accent     — chance of a note being an accent (loud)
3  Slide      — chance of a note sliding into the next
8  Gate       — note length as % of step time
Knobs 1–4 mark the pattern stale — press NEW (pad 1)
to regenerate, or Mutate (pad 2) to nudge ~25% of steps.

sections.heading: Knobs — 303 mode
body: Live CC controller for a schwung-303 on the slot's
MIDI channel. The 8 knobs send standard 303 CCs:
On 303-mode entry, knob values sync to the plugin's
current params so the first turn doesn't jump.

sections.heading: Pages (Step buttons 1–5)
body: In 303 mode, pages 2 and 3 show 303 Control 1/2 with
live CC readouts for K1–K4 and K5–K8.

sections.heading: Pads (4 rows, top = row 3)
body: Row 3 (top): steps 1–8 of the current step page.
Row 2:       steps 9–16 of the current step page.
Tap cycles rest → note → accent → slide.
Tap = recall (queued to next bar if
playing), Shift+tap = save current to bank.
Row 0:       1 NEW    regenerate from a fresh seed
3 DIR    cycle Fwd / Rev / Ping / Rnd

sections.heading: Hardware buttons
body: Undo         revert last NEW / MUTATE / CLEAR

sections.heading: LED colors
body: Yellow flash = bank queued for next-bar recall.
Shift held: row pulses red/pink (save targets).
Actions: teal NEW, indigo MUT, orange DIR.

sections.heading: Suspend & exit
body: Back            hide TB-3PO and keep both slots
Re-open from Tools → resumes with patterns + position

sections.heading: Sync
body: Tempo follows Move's project BPM automatically.
TB-3PO runs free (not gated by Move's transport) —
use the Play button to start/stop.
